note: Triennial election of councillors (two per ward), polled on Wednesday 17 May 1967. The Belfast Telegraph nomination report shows contests in Townparks, Gardenmore and Inver and two nominees for the two seats in each of Central and Curran wards, who were returned unopposed (also thanked in their own notices in the Larne Times, 11 May 1967). Two nominees for two seats. Printed 'Central'. Returned unopposed.
